mapper.sql: d.id, d.workspace_id, d.req_id, d.demand_no, d.title, d.description, d.source, d.item_kind, d.category_id, d.priority, d.status, d.close_reason, d.close_stage, d.expect_date, d.planned_start, d.planned_end, d.revision, d.accept_text, d.version_id, COALESCE(v.name, d.version_name) AS versionName, v.status AS versionStatus, d.review_note, d.wsjf_business, d.wsjf_urgency, d.wsjf_risk, d.wsjf_effort, d.created_by, d.created_at, d.updated_at

( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_member wmr WHERE wmr.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND wmr.user_id = #{q.userId} AND wmr.role IN ('owner', 'admin')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_member wm WHERE wm.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{q.userId} AND wm.role <> 'viewer' AND ( d.req_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pmw WHERE pmw.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pmw.project_id = d.req_id AND pmw.user_id = #{q.userId} AND pmw.access = 'write') OR ((wm.project_access_mode IS NULL OR wm.project_access_mode <> 'assigned') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pmr WHERE pmr.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pmr.project_id = d.req_id AND pmr.user_id = #{q.userId} AND pmr.access IN ('none', 'read'))) )) )

choose.when: ORDER BY FIELD(d.priority, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3'), d.updated_at DESC, d.id
ORDER BY d.expect_date IS NULL, d.expect_date, d.id

mapper.select:
SELECT d.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM demand d
GROUP BY d.status
